SELECT seqReservation.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblReservation ( reservation_id, user_id, user_route_id, status_id, reservation_price, reservation_start_date, reservation_end_date ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{userRouteId}, NVL(#{statusId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), #{reservationPrice}, TO_DATE(#{reservationStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{reservationEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )

SELECT seqAccomReservation.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblAccomReservation ( accom_reservation_id, room_id, reservation_id, user_route_id, status_id, guest_count, room_total_price, checkin_date, checkout_date, accom_notes ) VALUES ( #{accomReservationId}, #{roomId}, #{reservationId}, #{userRouteId}, NVL(#{statusId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), #{guestCount}, #{roomTotalPrice}, TO_DATE(#{checkinDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{checkoutDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{accomNotes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

SELECT seqCarReservation.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tblCarReservation ( car_reservation_id, car_id, reservation_id, user_route_id, status_id, pickup_date, dropoff_date, pickup_location, dropoff_location, car_total_price, car_notes ) VALUES ( #{carReservationId}, #{carId}, #{reservationId}, #{userRouteId}, NVL(#{statusId, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), TO_DATE(#{pickupDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{dropoffDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{pickupLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dropoffLocation, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{carTotalPrice}, #{carNotes, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, a.accom_id AS accomId, p.place_name AS accomName, r.room_name AS roomName, r.price_per_night AS pricePerNight, p.place_address AS address, p.place_lat AS lat, p.place_lng AS lng, r.room_image_url AS imageUrl FROM tblPlaceLocation pl JOIN tblPlace p ON p.place_location_id = pl.place_location_id JOIN tblAccom a ON a.place_id = p.place_id JOIN tblAccomRoom r ON r.accom_id = a.accom_id WHERE pl.place_location_name = #{region} AND r.room_status = 'y' ORDER BY p.place_name, r.room_name
SELECT price_per_night FROM tblAccomRoom WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND room_status = 'y'
SELECT car_price_per_day FROM tblRentalCar WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND car_status = 'y'

SELECT r.room_id AS roomId, a.accom_id AS accomId, p.place_name AS accomName, r.room_name AS roomName, r.price_per_night AS pricePerNight, p.place_address AS address, p.place_lat AS lat, p.place_lng AS lng, r.room_image_url AS imageUrl FROM tblPlace p JOIN tblAccom a ON a.place_id = p.place_id JOIN tblAccomRoom r ON r.accom_id = a.accom_id WHERE r.room_id = #{roomId} AND r.room_status = 'y'

SELECT car_id AS carId, place_location_id AS placeLocationId, car_name AS carName, car_type AS carType, car_number AS carNumber, car_fuel_type AS fuelType, car_seats AS seats, car_price_per_day AS pricePerDay, car_image_url AS carImageUrl FROM tblRentalCar WHERE car_id = #{carId} AND car_status = 'y'
SELECT DISTINCT car_type FROM tblRentalCar WHERE car_status = 'y'
SELECT DISTINCT car_fuel_type FROM tblRentalCar WHERE car_status = 'y'
SELECT DISTINCT car_seats FROM tblRentalCar WHERE car_status = 'y' ORDER BY car_seats
